NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NO. PL 212/2026 (COASTAL)
CATEGORY: SECURITY-RELATED REQUIREMENTS
AREA: SOUTHERN BALTIC. LOCALISATION: POLISH COAST, POMERANIAN BAY. CHART INT1295.
DUE TO MILITARY EXERCISES AREA BOUNDED BY POSITIONS: 1. 54-12.01N 014-33.98E 2. 54-14.51N 014-30.78E 3. 54-15.51N 014-34.78E 4. 54-13.01N 014-37.08E IS TEMPORARILY DANGEROUS FOR SHIPPING AND FISHERY: ON 2026-09-07 FROM 06:00 TO 14:00 ON 2026-09-08 FROM 06:00 TO 14:00 ON 2026-09-10 FROM 05:00 TO 14:00 TIME IN UTC
TERM OF VALIDITY: FROM 07 SEP 2026, 06:00 (UTC) TO 10 SEP 2026, 14:00 (UTC)
REMARKS: EXTREME CAUTION ADVISED
PROMULGATED 03 SEP 2026. HYDROGRAPHIC OFFICE OF THE POLISH NAVY, POLISH COORDINATOR OF RADIO NAVIGATIONAL WARNINGS.
